feature_groups.title: 11.1 Manage Security Clearance
feature_groups.verifiable: Upon CRO(Undertakings)’s submission of request for security clearance, system shall generate an email to inform MHA Office rep of a task pending his/her action. Upon clicking on the Manage Security Clearance module, system shall display a summary of all security clearance tasks and also shows basic information of each task. By default, all requests/tasks shall be displayed and MHA Office rep shall be able to display them based on the selected status, i.e. 'By-pass', 'Cleared', 'Rejected', or 'Request clarification'. When MHA Office rep clicks on each task, system shall display information of the requests and attachments included in the task. There shall be a function for him/her to export/download the information. He/she shall be able to download the ACRA files included by CRO(Undertakings) via the Manage Undertaking Requirements module. Each task shall have a status. a. b. New. This is the default status for all new requests. Processing. MHA Office rep shall be able to change the status from ‘New’ to ‘In-process’ once he/she start processing the request. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to view the status. c. Cleared. MHA Office rep shall be able to set the status to ‘Cleared’ when all security clearance is completed.  System shall have a mandatory ‘security clearance expiry date’ field and the default is no expiry (e.g. 31-12-9999). MHA Office rep can replace the value with a future date when updating the status to ‘Cleared’.  An email notification shall also be sent to inform Controller Undertakings Office / Controller Undertakings to follow-up on the next step, i.e. approve the undertaking requirement.  An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) of the status. If the security clearance expiry date is updated by MHA Office, the email shall inform CRO(Undertakings) of this expiry date. d. Request clarification. MHA Office rep shall be able to ask for clarification (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) of MHA Office’s clarification request. System shall auto set the status to ‘Request clarification’ and the task shall be routed back to CRO(Undertakings) for follow-up. e. Reply to Clarification Request. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to reply to MHA Office (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform MHA Office of CRO(Undertakings)’s reply. System shall auto set the status to ‘Reply to Clarification’ and the task shall be routed back to MHA Office for follow-up. f. Rejected. MHA Office rep shall be able to set the request to ‘Rejected’ and select the appropriate reason for rejection, e.g. Incomplete information, Incomplete documents, Company clearance not successful, Personnel clearance not successful, Others. When ‘Others’ is selected, system shall require MHA Office rep to state the reasons (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) that the request is rejected, the reason for rejection and any additional remarks indicated by MHA Office rep. g. Re-Submitted. For rejected request, the task shall be routed back to CRO(Undertakings) for follow-up. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to make amendments to the security clearance request, attach new documents and re- submit the request to MHA Office. The status shall be updated as ‘Re- Submitted’ automatically. An email notification shall be sent to inform MHA Office that CRO(Undertakings) has re-submitted an existing request. h. By-Pass. For task that have not been set to ‘Cleared’ status, Chief Controller Office can select 'By-Pass'. All requests with ‘By-Pass’ status are to be made similarly to how ‘Cleared’ requested are managed. MHA Office rep shall be able to view all past and current requests that have been routed to them. He/She shall be able to export/download the information. a. feature_groups.title: 14.2 Approve Asset Exemption
feature_groups.verifiable:
System shall generate and trigger an email to the respective Controllers to notify him/her there is an asset exemption/un-exemption request pending his/her approval. If the request is not processed, an email shall be sent to the respective Controller every 7-day interval to remind him/her of the outstanding cases.
Controllers shall be able to approve or reject the request. If there are multiple assets listed in the same request, he/she can select single or multiple assets for approval or rejection. When rejecting the request, Controller is required to state the reason(s) for the rejection. System shall generate and trigger an email to Requester(Asset_SAF), Requestor(Asset_WOG) to inform him/her that Controller has processed the request and he/she shall check the status in CRIPS. For assets exemption/un-exemption for a large list of CR assets, Controllers may prefer to review the request offline. Upon completion of the review, Controller shall be able to mass upload the list of CR assets he/she approve to exempt/un-exempt and system shall a. Have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load into CRIPS. b. Have a function to upload a filled template containing all the information needed to mass upload the exempted assets into CRIPS. System shall ensure that exempted assets cannot be allocated nor requisitioned. When EMA_AO or EMA_EO attempt to requisition an exempted asset, system shall prompt appropriate message to inform him/her the asset is exempted from requisition. Controllers shall be able to export/download the information. Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

feature_groups.title: 14.5 Manage ReqCen Allocation
feature_groups.verifiable:
System shall restrict by CR types according to the respective Controller’s access rights, a. CR Vehicles, CR Heavy Plants (applicable for Controller Vehicles) b. CR Vessels, CR Craft (applicable for Controller Vessels) c. CR Aircraft (applicable for Controller Aircraft)
System shall aggregate the CR requirements to allow the Controllers to maintain an overview of the national demand and the allocation status of the various CR categories to facilitate him/her to source from the national supply pool and allocate suitable CR owners or assets to the ReqCens.
System shall display the list of CR requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the selected ReqCen. Upon selection of a different ReqCen, system shall display the list of requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the newly selected ReqCen.
System shall display a prompt for the Controllers to review any new suggestion for allocation from AAP. On click of allocation summary, system shall display CR owner allocation details for the Controllers to perform allocation. For each CR category required by the ReqCen, system shall display the relevant information, grouped into four key tabs: a. Allocated CR Owner  System shall display the list of CR owners allocated to the ReqCen for the selected CR category upon expansion of the allocation summary. System shall display the total number of allocation by estab CR category.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  To update CR Owner Allocation (Allocated CR Owner), o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the tab as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary. o When there is a need to reduce the allocated quantity, EEs’ existing allocation would be reviewed first, followed by that of SAF units. As such, any deletion, if required, will start from the EE with the lowest allocation (sorted by alphabetical order), followed by the deletion of SAF units, starting from the lowest allocation (sorted by alphabetical order). o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. b. Substitution CR Owners Allocation  System shall display the list of CR owners with substituted CR categories allocated to the ReqCen. System shall display the total number of allocation by substitution CR category.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  On New Substitution link click, system shall display a popup window to allow user to perform substitution allocation.  To update Substitution CR Owner Allocation, o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the tab as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary. o When there is a need to reduce the allocated quantity, EEs’ existing allocation would be reviewed first, followed by that of SAF units. As such, any deletion, if required, will start from the EE with the lowest allocation (sorted by alphabetical order), followed by the deletion of SAF units, starting from the lowest allocation (sorted by alphabetical order). o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. c. New Substitution Allocation  System shall display the full list of CR categories excluding the estab CR category for substitution.  On change of Substitution CR Category, system shall display a list of CR owners with the selected substitution CR category.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  To update New Substitution Allocation to ReqCen, o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the tab as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary, as well as the list of Substituted CR owners. o When the Controllers updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. d. Not Allocated CR Owners  System shall display the list of CR owners not allocated to any ReqCen.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  To update Allocation (for Non-allocated CR Owner),  When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the “Allocated” tab “Substituted” tab, as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary.  System shall regard the allocation as a substitution if the CR category selected is different from the estab category.  When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. e. Allocated to Other ReqCens  System shall display the list of CR owners allocated to other ReqCens other than the selected ReqCen.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  To update Allocation (for CR Owners Allocated to Other ReqCen), o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the “Allocated” tab “Substituted” tab, as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary. o System shall regard the allocation as a substitution if the CR category selected is different from the estab category. o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. f. Automatic Allocation Program  System shall display the list of suggested CR owners and quantity.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  On ‘Accept Allocation’ button click, system shall prompt for Controller’s confirmation to replace the current allocation with the AAP allocation. Upon confirmation, system shall proceed to replace the current allocation and delete the AAP suggestion from the database.  On ‘Ignore’ button click, system shall delete the AAP suggestion from the database. System shall also delete the prompt for the Controller to review the AAP suggestion.  System shall automatically refresh AAP suggestion based on pre- defined business rules.  To edit quantity for Automatic Allocation Program, o When the Controller edits the quantity and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the “Allocated” tab “Substituted” tab, as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary. o When the Controller edits the quantity and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

user_stories.title: 11.1 Manage Security Clearance
user_stories.verifiable: Upon CRO(Undertakings)’s submission of request for security clearance, system shall generate an email to inform MHA Office rep of a task pending his/her action. Upon clicking on the Manage Security Clearance module, system shall display a summary of all security clearance tasks and also shows basic information of each task. By default, all requests/tasks shall be displayed and MHA Office rep shall be able to display them based on the selected status, i.e. 'By-pass', 'Cleared', 'Rejected', or 'Request clarification'. When MHA Office rep clicks on each task, system shall display information of the requests and attachments included in the task. There shall be a function for him/her to export/download the information. He/she shall be able to download the ACRA files included by CRO(Undertakings) via the Manage Undertaking Requirements module. Each task shall have a status. a. b. New. This is the default status for all new requests. Processing. MHA Office rep shall be able to change the status from ‘New’ to ‘In-process’ once he/she start processing the request. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to view the status. c. Cleared. MHA Office rep shall be able to set the status to ‘Cleared’ when all security clearance is completed.  System shall have a mandatory ‘security clearance expiry date’ field and the default is no expiry (e.g. 31-12-9999). MHA Office rep can replace the value with a future date when updating the status to ‘Cleared’.  An email notification shall also be sent to inform Controller Undertakings Office / Controller Undertakings to follow-up on the next step, i.e. approve the undertaking requirement.  An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) of the status. If the security clearance expiry date is updated by MHA Office, the email shall inform CRO(Undertakings) of this expiry date. d. Request clarification. MHA Office rep shall be able to ask for clarification (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) of MHA Office’s clarification request. System shall auto set the status to ‘Request clarification’ and the task shall be routed back to CRO(Undertakings) for follow-up. e. Reply to Clarification Request. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to reply to MHA Office (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform MHA Office of CRO(Undertakings)’s reply. System shall auto set the status to ‘Reply to Clarification’ and the task shall be routed back to MHA Office for follow-up. f. Rejected. MHA Office rep shall be able to set the request to ‘Rejected’ and select the appropriate reason for rejection, e.g. Incomplete information, Incomplete documents, Company clearance not successful, Personnel clearance not successful, Others. When ‘Others’ is selected, system shall require MHA Office rep to state the reasons (free text field). An email notification shall be sent to inform CRO(Undertakings) that the request is rejected, the reason for rejection and any additional remarks indicated by MHA Office rep. g. Re-Submitted. For rejected request, the task shall be routed back to CRO(Undertakings) for follow-up. CRO(Undertakings) shall be able to make amendments to the security clearance request, attach new documents and re- submit the request to MHA Office. The status shall be updated as ‘Re- Submitted’ automatically. An email notification shall be sent to inform MHA Office that CRO(Undertakings) has re-submitted an existing request. h. By-Pass. For task that have not been set to ‘Cleared’ status, Chief Controller Office can select 'By-Pass'. All requests with ‘By-Pass’ status are to be made similarly to how ‘Cleared’ requested are managed. MHA Office rep shall be able to view all past and current requests that have been routed to them. He/She shall be able to export/download the information. a. System shall have filter and sort functions for new and existing undertakings' security request (by Ministry/Agency, by date e.g. month/Year, by Company Name and UEN). b. System shall have search function (by name of Ministry/Agency; by Company Name and UEN, by date of approval of registration and de- registration). c. MHA Office rep shall be able to list all the requests that are pending clearance and have an indication that it is pending clearance. Requests with status ‘New’, ‘Processing’, ‘Reply to Clarification’, ‘Re-Submitted’ are considered as pending clearance. d. MHA Office rep shall be able to list all undertakings that are pending security clearance, and have additional details such status, date of request, date of last action taken for internal analysis on the duration taken for clearance. e. f. g. h. i. MHA Office rep shall be able to list all undertakings registered by the Ministry/Agency, Date of Registration. MHA Office rep shall be able to list all undertakings that are security-cleared and by ‘Date of Clearance’. MHA Office rep shall be able to list all undertakings that are security-cleared and are registered by the different Ministry/Agency, Lead Agency/Sector Lead, Coordinating Agency. System shall have filter and sort functions for undertakings that is/are de- registered (by Ministry/Agency, by Date e.g. month/Year, by Company Name and UEN). MHA Office rep shall be able to list all undertakings that are de-registered by Ministry/Agency and the date of de-registration. 12. APPROVING OFFICER(UNDERTAKING) USER STORY

user_stories.title: 13.1 Manage Annual Exercise Plans
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall display a summary of all ReqCens, the ReqCen Description, Previous and Last Exercise Dates and the Planned Exercise Workyear (e.g. WY 2025).
The Previous and Last CR Exercise Dates shall be updated automatically after ReqCen has completed their CR exercise.
System shall derive the Planned Exercise Workyear for each ReqCen taking reference from its last exercise dates. A mapping table shall be set-up to define the mapping logic for Planned Exercise Workyear. For example, the planned exercise workyear for ReqCen A is +3 years from its last exercise date.
System shall show the most current Planned Exercise Workyear if this information is updated by the respective Controller.
Upon clicking onto the respective ReqCen’s previous or last CR exercise date, system shall display the exercise scale, i.e. the number of CR owners and the number of CR assets participated in that exercise.

user_stories.title: 13.3 Manage Security Clearance
user_stories.verifiable:
Upon clicking on the Manage Security Clearance module, system shall display a summary of all security clearance tasks.
For each task, system shall show basic information, e.g. UEN, Company Name, Requesting Agency, Date of Submission for Clearance, Clearance Status, etc.
For tasks that are still pending clearance, Chief Controller shall be able to click on the UEN or Company Name to launch the task for further processing. He/She shall be able to select ‘By-Pass’, enter a reference number, security clearance/by-pass date which are mandatory fields. He shall also be able to enter comments (free text) and this is not a mandatory field. Upon completion, he/she shall click on ‘Submit’ or he/she shall click on ‘Back’ to return to the previous page.
Chief Controller Office shall be able to search using keywords such as UEN and Company Name. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.
Upon completion of the ‘By-Pass’ security clearance process, an email notification shall be sent to inform MHA Office and the relevant CRO(Undertakings) of the status. An email notification shall also be sent to inform Controller Undertakings Office / Controller Undertakings to follow-up on the next step, i.e. approve the undertaking requirement. Chief Controller Office shall be able to export/download all tasks and details of each task.

user_stories.title: 13.4 Approve Requisition Plans
user_stories.verifiable:
At the Approve Requisition Plan module, Chief Controller Office shall be able to choose ‘Requisition Plan (Assets)’ or ‘Requisition Plan (Undertakings).
System shall display all Requisition Plans and grouped them by tabs according to the status of each plan, i.e. 'Pending Approval', 'Approved', and 'Rejected'. Plans that were approved and committed by CROs shall also be listed and displayed as part of ‘Approved’ Requisition Plans.
For Requisition Plan (Assets), a. For each plan, system shall show detailed information such as Requisition Plan ID and Name, Description, Unit, ReqCen, Requisition Plan Type, Start Date, End Date, Approved/Rejected by, Approved/Rejected on, Duration, Mobilisation Type, Number of CR Owners Involved, Number of Assets Involved, Number of Owners Activated for the first time, Primary and Secondary EMA, Participating CR Owners and their UEN, Earmarked CR Category and Quantity for each CR Owner. b. Upon clicking on a specific requisition plan, system shall display the actual requisition plan and display all information related to the plan. c. For plans that are pending approval, Chief Controller Office shall be able to approve or reject the plan. He/She shall be required to select the Approval Type (i.e. ‘by Minister’ or ‘by President’), Approval Reference, Approval Reference Date and Remarks (mandatory when ‘Reject’ is selected’).
For Requisition Plan (Undertakings), a. For each plan, system shall show detailed information such as Requisition Plan ID, Company/Firm and their UEN, Requesting Agency, Requisition Plan Type, Start Date, End Date, Approved/Rejected by, Approved/Rejected on, Duration, Number of Companies/Firms Involved. b. Upon clicking on a specific requisition plan, system shall display the actual requisition plan and display all information related to the plan. c. For plans that are pending approval, Chief Controller Office shall be able to approve or reject the plan.
